links.outcome: Adequacy of evaluation metrics for detecting clinical information removal in LLM de-identification
links.effect: Traditional classification metrics are inadequate for LLM errors that alter clinical information; an existing metric was manually validated by clinical experts and showed poor performance.
links.quote: We highlight poor performance and describe the inherent limitations of such metrics in identifying clinically significant changes.

links.outcome: Consistency of reporting standards across LLM de-identification papers
links.effect: The survey found heterogeneous reporting standards and inconsistent metrics, hindering direct comparison and reproducibility.
links.quote: Although these approaches often report near-perfect results, significant challenges concerning reproducibility and utility of the research papers persist.

unlisted_practices: Metric for detecting removal of clinically relevant information during LLM de-identification

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks LLM de-identification safety and information loss, validating evaluation metrics with clinical experts.

primary.practice: clinical information loss evaluation during de-identification
